own immutable snapshot of the definition at launch.\n- [List swarms](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-swarms.md)\
n- [Create a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/create-a-swarm.md): A swarm is an authoring container holding DEF
AULTS for the goals made under it. Creating one starts nothing.\n- [Get a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-
a-swarm.md)\n- [Archive a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/archive-a-swarm.md): ARCHIVES the container. The goa
ls authored under it are not touched: they keep their own definitions and stay launchable.\n- [Update a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam
.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-swarm.md): Changes the container's DEFAULTS. Goals already authored under it keep the values th
ey were created with: this is not a cascade.\n- [List journeys](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-journeys.md): Th
e project's goals, newest first. Archived goals are excluded.\n- [Create a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/c
reate-a-journey.md): Creates one goal: a persona pursuing a task against one or more environments. To draft several with a model f
irst, use `POST /projects/{projectId}/goals/generate`: that route persists nothing.\n- [List secrets](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-
reference/secrets/list-secrets.md): The project's credentials as METADATA ONLY: no value is returned by this or any other route. S
hows the project-shared secrets plus the caller's own personal ones; another member's personal secret does not appear at all, not
even its name.\n- [Create a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/create-a-secret.md): Store a credential so envir
onments can grant it to runs. THE VALUE TRAVELS IN THE REQUEST BODY and becomes visible to whatever makes the call. The response i
s metadata only. Creating a project-shared secret requires project admin; a personal one does not.\n- [Get a secret](https://docs.
mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/get-a-secret.md): One secret's metadata: delivery mode, host binding, sharing, and when it was la
st handed to a run. Never its value. A secret from another project (and another member's personal secret) both read as 404.\n- [De
lete a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/delete-a-secret.md): Delete a stored credential. HARD: the row and th
e encrypted value both go, and MCPJam stops delivering it. Deliberately NOT blocked when an environment still selects it: refusing
would leave a leaked credential undeletable until someone edited every environment naming it, and deletion must never wai…\n- [Ro
tate or re-bind a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/rotate-or-re-bind-a-secret.md): Rotate the value and/or ch
ange how it is delivered. A rotation reaches NEW RUNS ONLY: a session already running holds the old value (materialized in its box
's environment, or inside an egress policy that cannot be read back) and there is no safe way to replace it mid-run.\n- [List a jo
urney's runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/list-a-journeys-runs.md): Newest first. Compact records: `attempts`
is on the single-run read.\n- [Launch a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/launch-a-journey.md): Answers *
*202**: the run row exists and its fan-out has started. It is not finished. Poll `GET /projects/{projectId}/goal-runs/{runId}` unt
il `status` leaves `running`.\n- [Get a journey run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/get-a-journey-run.md): The f
ull record, including per-session `attempts` and `targetSummaries`.\n- [List a run's sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referen
ce/swarm-runs/list-a-runs-sessions.md): One entry per chat session the run produced. Summaries, not transcripts. Read a transcript
through the chat-session routes using `id`.\n- [Cancel a journey run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/cancel-a-j
ourney-run.md): Accepts a durable Stop request and returns immediately. cleanupPending indicates that attempts are being settled i
n the background; status remains the current stored run status. IDEMPOTENT: cancelling an already-cancelled run answers 200 with `
alreadyCanceled: true` and `finalized: 0`, not a 409.\n- [Project swarm roll-up](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insig
hts/project-swarm-roll-up.md): Recent runs with their goal-completion rates and repeat-failure findings, plus a project-wide trend
. Deterministic and free. Start here.\n- [Get a run's rubric scorecard](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/get-a
-runs-rubric-scorecard.md): The deterministic rubric result for one run. No model, no spend.\n- [List swarm findings](https://docs
.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/list-swarm-findings.md): Criteria that keep failing, tracked across waves. One finding is
one problem OVER TIME: `occurrenceCount` and `status` carry the history, so do not treat repeat appearances as separate problems.
\n- [Dismiss a finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/dismiss-a-finding.md): Hides a finding from your view
. ORTHOGONAL to `status`: dismissing does not claim the problem stopped happening, and a dismissed finding that fires again stays
`recurring`.\n- [Undismiss a finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/undismiss-a-finding.md): Reverses a dis
missal. Bodyless, like its twin.\n- [Get swarm run insights](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/get-swarm-run-in
sights.md): Poll this after requesting insights. **404 means nobody asked**: it is deliberately not an empty `status: \"none\"` bo
dy, so a caller in a polling loop cannot mistake \"never requested\" for \"asked and still working\".\n- [Request swarm run insigh
ts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/request-swarm-run-insights.md): Answers **202**: generation is scheduled,
not done. Poll the GET above rather than re-requesting.\n- [Cancel a pending swarm-run-insights generation](https://docs.mcpjam.c
om/api-reference/swarm-insights/cancel-a-pending-swarm-run-insights-generation.md): Stops a generation that is still `pending`. A
swarm run with no generation in progress answers 409: there is nothing to cancel, and reporting success would tell a caller it sto
pped something it did not.\n- [Request insights for an eval run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/request-insights-for-
an-eval-run.md): **No credits are consumed**: the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the finished run and draws on the sam
e shared `insightsPerDay` request ledger as swarm and user-testing insights.\n- [Grade an eval run with LLM as Judge](https://docs
.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/grade-an-eval-run-with-llm-as-judge.md): **Spends.** Runs the goal-completion judge over the finis
hed run, scoring each case's final answer against its expected output.\n- [Start a Claude directory-readiness run](https://docs.mc
pjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-a-claude-directory-readiness-run.md): Grades the saved server against Anthropic's
connector-directory requirements and returns `202` with a run id. The target comes from the saved server the path names: a body c
annot supply a URL, an actor, an organization, a model or a cost. Poll the run detail for the verdict. Deterministic grading is…\n
- [Start an OpenAI plugin-directory readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-an-openai-plugi
n-directory-readiness-run.md): Grades the saved server against OpenAI's plugin-directory requirements and returns `202` with a run
id. `submissionMode` is required and never inferred: inferring it would read a forgotten package as `mcp-only` and report the pac
kage lane not-applicable, turning a missing input into a clean bill of…\n- [Start a Muse connector readiness run](https://docs.mcp
jam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-a-muse-connector-readiness-run.md): Grades the saved server against Meta's Muse co
nnector guidelines and returns `202` with a run id. Free: Muse readiness has no AI observations, so the body has no field that can
spend, and no submission mode, which belongs to the OpenAI plugin directory. The submission-ready verdict stays `incomplete…\n- [
List readiness runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/list-readiness-runs.md)\n- [Read one readiness run]
(https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/read-one-readiness-run.md): Lane statuses, coverage and the observation
